body: Glossy 3D clay die-cut sticker with a thick white border on a fully transparent background. A yellow five-pointed star wearing tiny round sunglasses makes one small hop, lands softly, and returns to the exact starting stance. Locked front camera, crisp cutout edge, flat vibrant colors, no text.
